originalTitle: Manipal Health moves closer to Rs 10,000-cr IPO after Sebi nod
simplifiedContent: Manipal Health Enterprises is getting closer to raising a large amount of money, about 10,000 crore rupees, by selling shares to the public for the first time. The company just got approval from the market regulator, Sebi, to do this. The money raised will be used to pay off debts and to buy a stake in another company. This is a big step for Manipal Health as it plans to expand its business. The approval from Sebi is an important milestone in the company's plan to go public and raise the necessary funds for its growth plans.

originalTitle: US stocks today: Nasdaq jumps over 1% as chip stocks rally, investors eye AI earnings
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the US stock market: the Nasdaq, a major stock market index, went up by over 1% today. This is because companies that make computer chips, like Broadcom, did well due to excitement about artificial intelligence (AI) and expecting good earnings. However, Microsoft's stock went down after they announced they would be cutting jobs. Investors are now waiting to see how companies do in their upcoming earnings reports and what the Federal Reserve (Fed) will do next, as they're unsure about interest rates. This uncertainty is making investors cautious about what will happen next.

originalTitle: NY Fed says supply chain pressures eased in June
simplifiedContent: The New York Fed, which is part of the US central bank, says that problems with getting goods from one place to another around the world are getting a little better. In June, these problems, known as supply chain pressures, decreased, which is a good sign. This decrease is partly because things are getting back to normal in the Middle East, which is an important route for sending goods by ship. This could help reduce inflation, which is when prices for goods and services go up. Even though things are getting better, there are still some issues with getting goods delivered on time, which might cause some ongoing problems.

originalTitle: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold tops $4,200, silver nears $64 as recovery rally extends; Fed minutes in focus
simplifiedContent: The prices of gold and silver went up a bit on July 6th. This happened because people are less worried that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates, and the value of the US dollar is a bit lower. As a result, gold prices reached $4,215 and silver prices reached $63.73, which is an improvement from their previous lower prices. This matters because it shows that investors are feeling more positive about these precious metals. The increase in gold and silver prices is a sign of a recovery from previous losses.

originalTitle: Trent Q1 business update: Revenue grows 19%, store network expands
simplifiedContent: Trent, a company owned by the Tata Group, had a good first quarter with its sales increasing by 19% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹5,666 crore. The company also opened more stores, bringing its total to 1,312 outlets. This news is important because it shows that Trent is growing and expanding its business. As a result, the company's stock price increased by 17.2% in 2026, although it's still not at its all-time high. This increase in stock price is significant because it indicates that investors are optimistic about the company's performance.

originalTitle: Rentomojo gets SEBI nod for raising funds through IPO launch. Details here
simplifiedContent: Rentomojo, a company that rents out furniture, has gotten approval from a group called SEBI to raise money by selling shares to the public. This is called an IPO, or initial public offering. The company wants to raise up to ₹150 crore to help it grow and pay off debts. This is a big deal for Rentomojo because it will give them the money they need to expand their business. The company is already a major player in India's online rental market, so this move could help them become even stronger.
